## LitQuest

LitQuest is an interactive web and mobile application designed to address adult literacy challenges by making classic literature into visual novels. It was created within 24 hours during SparkHacks 2026.

### Skills Showcased

\- Web development and Application Prototype

\- Collaboration with a team of 5

\- Designing technology for social impact and accessibility

\- ReactJS, JavaScript, Figma, MongoDB
